scope: One held BON clear-transport LW diagnostic45 (32 native +13 upper extensions), physical bands3-13 only. Own 140/128 gpoints, tau and subband fractions stay with their engine. Source-envelope counterfactuals are not production modifications.

formulas.native_faces: Legacy layer-local fraction at both faces; GP firstface layer1 fraction then geometric sqrt(pfrac[k-1]*pfrac[k]) at each interior lowerface.
formulas.shared_SI: Use retained independent SI-direct band radiance at exact concat(TLAY45,TLEV46,TSFC1). No new SI integration or interpolation is evaluated.
formulas.layer_local_faces: Only GP boundary fraction changes to its own layer fraction; legacy unchanged. Bottom layer must have exactly zero face-policy effect.
formulas.isothermal: Layer source radiance replaces lowerface source radiance, with own layer fractions and tau unchanged. This is an extra diagnostic counterfactual, not a forecast/state change.
formulas.closure: baseline shared-angle residual=(baseline-sharedSI)+(sharedSI-bothlocal)+(bothlocal residual). This is an ordered path of linear-source counterfactuals, not a unique order-independent decomposition.
formulas.weight_sum_bound: For sharedSI/layerlocal emitter c, bound hypothetical unit-sum weight rescaling by sum(abs(c)*abs((sum_weights-1)/sum_weights)); sum=0 allowed only when c=0. No fraction/source/tau normalization actually performed.

limitations: No source-fraction normalization, gpoint pairing, tau/source swapping across engines, coefficient edits, production policy changes or hidden clipping.

The sharedSI/localface residual combines own optical coefficients, correlated-k discretization and within-band Planck fractions. It is not an exclusive tau difference or spectroscopic accuracy verdict.
The SI-direct Planck law is a thermal-emission envelope reference, not an independent oracle for gas absorption or source-fraction spectral correlation.
Boundary face fraction policy is an intended algorithm choice; sensitivity does not prove either host/engine implementation incorrect.

Incoming TOA downwelling must be zero and assembled GP opacity must exactly equal gas opacity. This specific call has no transported cloud contribution, not a generic hydrometeor-free model guarantee.
Per-emitter, per-band and total convergence is checked against1e-9; no scientific difference tolerance is invented.
No new WRF/REAL/build/compiledRTE/replay/SIintegration; one Python source-emission/angle evaluation planned. No domain/native32 accuracy or physical accuracy winner.
